source_key_points: 7 Fractions Recall that when some whole number of things are shared equally among some number of people, fractions tell us how much each share is.
Shabnam: Do you remember, if one roti is divided equally between two children, how much roti will each child get?
We also sometimes read this as 2 ‘one upon two.’ Mukta: If one roti is equally shared among 4 children, how much roti will one child get?
Shabnam: When 2 children share 1 roti equally, each child gets 12 roti.
When 4 children share 1 roti equally, each child gets 14 roti.
